Every instructor at Skydive Golden Gate has made thousands of skydives and has spent years as a practicing professional tandem instructor. We do everything in our power to ensure a safe and fun skydive

blurb: Skydive Golden Gate is the closest skydive to San Francisco, just 24 miles north of the Golden Gate Bridge, and halfway between San Francisco and Napa Valley. As the only skydive near San Francisco, we have exclusive access to a flight to altitude that will take you over San Francisco’s major landmarks like Angel Island, Alcatraz and the Golden Gate Bridge with stunning views of the Northern California coastline,
